scope: Closed-loop native G1 planner encoder + H2 decoder + MuJoCo WASM. Direction targets are distinct learned-planner references, not rendered-pose translations.
limitations: This checks actual simulated state, not hardware or exact target-speed accuracy.
No browser UI, worker scheduling, or real-time pacing is exercised.
Minimum height and finite-state checks are sampled at the 50 Hz policy boundaries.
